Rahul Gandhi Criticizes Police Action Against Bihar Students

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized the police action against students protesting in Bihar, directing his criticism at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary. Gandhi questioned whether "shattered dreams" could be restored following the incident. The protests involved students from Bihar.
